name: Jarl Needs Eyes
summary: "Swamp Eye" Jarl at Swamplight Manor wants 40 unpopped Darkmist eyes, because Darkmist eye juice is smooth and salty. The spiders live in Darkmist Cavern, west of the manor.

sections.title: A Taste for Spider Eyes
sections.body: Following Soothing Spices, Jarl turns to eye juice, which is good for drinking. Most critters carry a mere pair of eyes, whereas spiders carry a great many, and Jarl finds Darkmist eye juice tasty. The Darkmist spiders live in Darkmist Cavern, west of the manor, and Jarl muses over whether the cave gave the spiders their name or the reverse.

sections.title: A Feast for Jarl
sections.body: Jarl cheers at the arrival of the eyes, calling them tasty. Jarl advises saving for last any that stare back when stared at, since they give a person something for company in the swamp. Jarl then greets the little eyes, tastes them and declares them like gooey, salty chicken.

faq.q: Who asks for the spider eyes?
faq.answer: "Swamp Eye" Jarl asks for them, at Swamplight Manor in Dustwallow Marsh.

faq.q: Why does Jarl want spider eyes?
aliases: what does jarl do with eyes
faq.answer: Jarl likes eye juice for drinking and finds Darkmist eye juice smooth and salty. Most critters have only two eyes, while spiders have a great many.
Jarl places the Darkmist spiders in Darkmist Cavern, to the west of Swamplight Manor.

faq.q: How many eyes does Jarl want?
